description: Table 9 is a purely tabular figure (no plot, micrograph or spectrum) that lists calculated strengthening-mechanism contributions against the phases of a non-equiatomic high entropy steel. The table has one row-header column, "Strengthening Mechanism", and two data columns under the shared header "Phases": "BCC" and "B2-type", separated from the header block by a horizontal rule. Reading down the rows: Frictional stress (σ₀) = 120 MPa (BCC) and 120 MPa (B2-type); Grain Boundary (Δσ_gb) = 1085 MPa and 1224 MPa; Dislocation (Δσ_d) = 687 MPa and 590 MPa; Precipitation (Δσ_p) = 54 MPa (silicides) + 111 MPa (B2-type) versus 55 MPa; Solid solution (Δσ_ss) = 106 MPa and 177 MPa. Two summary rows close the table: "Total contribution" with an empty BCC cell and 2164 MPa in the B2-type column, and "Experimental strength" with an empty BCC cell and 2046 MPa in the B2-type column. Both summary rows are printed in bold. The table therefore demonstrates that the summed theoretical contribution (2164 MPa) and the measured strength (2046 MPa) of the high entropy steel are in close agreement, with grain-boundary and dislocation terms dominating the total.

observations.observation: The table lists strengthening-mechanism contributions in MPa for two phases, BCC and B2-type, of a non-equiatomic high entropy steel.
Frictional stress (σ₀) is given as 120 MPa for BCC and 120 MPa for B2-type.
Grain boundary strengthening (Δσ_gb) is 1085 MPa for BCC and 1224 MPa for B2-type.
Dislocation strengthening (Δσ_d) is 687 MPa for BCC and 590 MPa for B2-type.
Precipitation strengthening (Δσ_p) is printed as '54 MPa (silicides) + 111 MPa (B2-type)' for BCC and 55 MPa for B2-type.
Solid solution strengthening (Δσ_ss) is 106 MPa for BCC and 177 MPa for B2-type.
'Total contribution' is 2164 MPa and 'Experimental strength' is 2046 MPa; both values appear only in the B2-type column, with the BCC cell empty, and both rows are bold.
The citing text states the calculated theoretical strength and the measured strength of the alloy are in close agreement.
The citing text states the calculation assumed 100% phase fraction for BCC and B2-type, while the SPSed sample had BCC 56.0% and B2-type 34.0%; the calculation used BCC 62.0% and B2-type 38.0%.
The citing text states grain boundary (52.55%) and dislocation (30.00%) strengthening are dominant, with precipitation 5.70% and solid solution 6.14%.

subfigures.description: Single-panel table titled by the caption as Table 9: rows are strengthening mechanisms (frictional stress, grain boundary, dislocation, precipitation, solid solution, total contribution, experimental strength); columns are the BCC and B2-type phases, with values in MPa. Total contribution (2164 MPa) and experimental strength (2046 MPa) appear only in the B2-type column and are bold.
